title: 第七章 将莫宁引荐给导师第八章 奖励
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
黑塔深处。
观测之间内。
最初，尖耳女学徒尚能勉强跟得上莫宁笔下跃动的思维轨迹。
虽然这种“跳跃式”的推导方式，让她感到非常不适应。
但她明白，对于真正精通秘法术数、脑中已构筑起完整逻辑大厦的天才而言，许多中间步骤确如呼吸般自然，无需诉诸笔墨。
譬如其中一步关于“恒等脉冲能量律动”的转换——“⊙446Θ”恒等于二倍的“⊙178◇”。
对于像莫宁这样的人来说，确实一目了然，何必写那么多“废话”呢？
可这对于“旁观者”而言，却极不友好。
每一次跳跃，都像逻辑的阶梯被凭空抽去几级台阶，迫使她必须耗费额外心力去填补空白。
她瞥了一眼光球中莫宁极为专注的侧脸，忍不住低声念叨道：“讨厌的小子！你这么做，该不会只是为了节省几张鳞纹纸吧？”
对于新人来说，学院提供的黑塔点确实捉襟见肘。
每月5黑塔点的食宿费用，仅仅包括基本的吃饭和住宿。
除此之外的一切物品和需求，通通需要自己想办法，要么自己动手，要么自行购置，鳞纹纸亦是如此。
由于开支太大，新人们精打细算、甚至捉襟见肘是常态，抠抠搜搜地使用鳞纹纸也是非常常见的事。
此刻她竟莫名生出一股冲动，想要派一个硬木傀儡，给804寓所塞上整整一柜子的鳞纹纸。
别省了，行不行？
五分钟后。
尖耳女学徒已经彻底跟不上节奏了。
纸面上的推导，跳跃得越来越恣意，符号与结论之间的逻辑链条，被压缩到了极致。
她的视线追逐着墨管笔，翡翠色眼眸中闪过一丝不甘。

毕竟身为三级学徒，此刻竟有被一个新人用最纯粹的“术数思维”碾压了，这实在有些伤及颜面。
然而理智冰冷地提醒着她，正如导师曾告诫的那样：“在秘法术数面前，所有人都是平等的。”
一小时后。
尖耳女学徒震惊了。
整整一个小时，光球中的蓝袍身影未曾有过丝毫松懈。
笔尖移动的速度、思维跳跃的频度、乃至那种沉浸于纯粹计算中散发出的“气场”，没有丝毫衰减的迹象。
正常来说，高强度的秘法术数推导，是对精神力与心智耐力的双重压榨。
以她自身为例，保持类似强度的专注与输出，半小时已是极限，随后效率必然下降。
而莫宁，他仿佛拥有一颗为计算而生的、不知疲倦的“永续核心”。
这种程度的脑力负荷，对他而言，似乎轻松得如同呼吸。
尖耳女学徒喃喃自语道：“我好像远远低估了这小子的天赋！”
四个小时过去了。
“……仅仅提升了3.2%，最终模型效能只有我理论预估的66.3%。
“太少了！”
当莫宁终于搁下墨管笔，轻轻活动了一下脖颈，很不满意的咕哝了一句。
尖耳女学徒已然陷入了某种近乎“麻木”的震撼之中。
3.2%！！
虽然只是对零级戏法【闪光】的能流脉冲峰值进行优化，可对于一个刚刚入门、理论上连灵环都未凝聚的新人而言，这个数值也堪称惊人。
居然还不满足？！
尖耳女学徒盯着莫宁的侧脸，心头有荒谬，也有恼怒。

唯独没有嫉妒。
因为她清楚地知道，双方在术数天赋方面的差距，宛若一条永远无法跨越的鸿沟。
所以她压根没有嫉妒的心思。
尖耳女学徒压下心头情绪，低语道：“不能再等了！”
content_en:
Deep in the Black Tower.
within the observation period.
At first, the pointed-eared female apprentice could barely keep up with the moving thoughts in Moning's writing.
Although this "leap-forward" derivation method made her feel very uncomfortable.
But she understood that for a genius who is truly proficient in arcane magic and has built a complete logical building in his mind, many intermediate steps are as natural as breathing, without resorting to writing.
For example, one step involves the conversion of "constant pulse energy rhythm" - "⊙446Θ" is equal to twice "⊙178◇".
For someone like Mourning, it is indeed clear at a glance, so why write so much "nonsense"?
But this is extremely unfriendly to "bystanders".
Every jump was like a few steps being removed from the ladder of logic, forcing her to spend extra effort to fill in the gaps.
She glanced at Mourning's extremely focused side face in her eyeballs, and couldn't help but mutter in a low voice: "Nasty boy! Are you doing this just to save a few pieces of scale paper?"
For newcomers, the black tower points provided by the academy are indeed scarce.
The monthly accommodation fee of 5 black tower points only includes basic meals and accommodation.
All other items and needs need to be figured out by yourself, either by yourself or by purchasing them yourself. The same is true for scale paper.
Due to the huge expenses, it is normal for new people to be careful about their budget and even be stretched thin. It is also very common for them to use scaled paper arbitrarily.
At this moment, she had an inexplicable urge to send a hardwood puppet to fill apartment 804 with a whole cabinet of scaled paper.
Don't worry about it, okay?
Five minutes later.
The pointed-eared female apprentice could no longer keep up with the rhythm.
The derivation on paper jumps more and more arbitrarily, and the logical chain between symbols and conclusions is compressed to the extreme.
Her eyes followed the ink pen, a trace of unwillingness flashed in her emerald eyes.
After all, as a third-level apprentice, at this moment, he was crushed by a newcomer using the purest "magical thinking". This was really a bit embarrassing.
However, her reason reminded her coldly, just as her mentor once warned: "Everyone is equal in front of the secret magic number."
One hour later.
The pointed-eared female apprentice was shocked.
For an entire hour, the blue-robed figure in the ball of light never relaxed at all.
The speed with which the pen tip moves, the frequency with which thoughts jump, and even the "aura" emitted by being immersed in pure calculations, show no signs of decay.
Normally, high-intensity mystical spell derivation is a double squeeze on mental power and mental endurance.
Taking herself as an example, maintaining a similar intensity of concentration and output for half an hour is already the limit, and then her efficiency will inevitably decline.
As for Mourning, he seems to have a tireless "sustainable core" born for calculation.
This level of mental load seemed as easy to him as breathing.
The pointed-eared female apprentice murmured to herself: "I seem to have greatly underestimated this boy's talent!"
Four hours passed.
“...It only improved by 3.2%, and the final model efficiency was only 66.3% of my theoretical estimate.
"Too little! "
When Mourning finally put down his ink pen, he moved his neck slightly and muttered in dissatisfaction.
The pointed-eared female apprentice has fallen into a state of shock that is almost "numb".
3.2%! !
Although it only optimizes the energy flow pulse peak of the zero-level trick [Flash], for a newcomer who has just started and theoretically has not even condensed the spiritual ring, this value is also amazing.
Not satisfied yet? !
The pointed-eared female apprentice stared at Mourning's profile, feeling both ridiculous and annoyed.
Only there is no jealousy.
Because she knew clearly that the gap in spell talent between the two sides was like a gap that could never be crossed.
So she didn't feel jealous at all.
Pointed-eared womanThe apprentice suppressed his emotions and whispered: "We can't wait any longer!"
